title: dev.qory.run.refused
description: The run did not start. Emitted in place of dev.qory.run.started, the run's first event after dev.qory.run.registered where there is one, heartbeats aside, and its last, by the session. A gateway refuses the session's run request, with a code in its answer on the link, unsigned and authenticated by the transport: the refusal opens no run at the gateway, the session records the run.refused it received, its code and names, only in the session's record, and nothing reaches the server for it. A session that fails after the gateway's run answer and before its process starts posts its run.refused on the link: the gateway holds that run, and delivers it. Events carry names and ids alone, never a value.

code.description: Why the run did not start: a refusal code of Forager, of qory, of the server, or of a gateway, the one the refusal's body contained: the server's in its signed answer, a gateway's in its answer on the link, unsigned. The codes Forager, qory, the server and a gateway share are the list the schema holds the code to when there is no status; the session writes the code of a gateway's 410 that closed the run before it started, run_closed, session_lost, batch_refused or stopped, with status 410, and the code of a gateway's refusal it received, the refusals of a separate gateway over the run key, run_key_invalid, run_attached, run_key_expired and wrong_gateway, among them, with no status. The list also holds workspace_not_served, which the session now writes with its status as the server's refusal of the attach, and the old codes run_credential_refused, target_differs_from_credential, differs_from_credential, credential_expired, credential_check_unreachable and credential_check_invalid, which Forager no longer writes, each kept so that records written before still validate. A code that came from the server comes with its status, and is kept as the server's body contained it, one the list does not hold yet included: a receiver shows a code it does not know as it is.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns: variables, tools, images, paths, an earlier or another run's id, or the names a server's or a gateway's coded refusal lists. A name never contains a value; records written before under the old codes target_differs_from_credential and differs_from_credential may contain names of the form <member>=<value>. A name that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_, qeci_ or qecd_ in any case is `(a name that contains an access key secret)` in its place, `(a name that contains a run key)` when it contains qrk_ and no qak_, `(a name that contains a run code)` when it contains qecr_ and neither of the others, or `(a name that contains an enrolment code)` when it contains qecn_, qecp_, qecg_, qeci_ or qecd_ and none of the others, each phrase once.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer, when the code came from the server, or from a gateway's 410 that ended the run before it started.
